left.title: All 5 Former U.S. Presidents Team Up to Raise $31 Million for Hurricane Victims
left.body: All five of the former living U.S. presidents made a rare appearance together in the name of hurricane relief Saturday night. They were even joined by current President Donald Trump — sort of.
left.roundup: All five former living U.S. presidents teamed up to raise $31 million for hurricane victims, appearing on stage together at a concert on Saturday evening. President Trump also made remarks via video.

center.title: Campaign from former presidents raises $31M for disaster relief
center.body: A fundraising campaign launched by all five living former U.S. presidents has raised $31 million in donations for disaster relief so far, after a series of hurricanes tore through different parts of the country.
center.roundup: All five former living U.S. presidents teamed up to raise $31 million for hurricane victims, appearing on stage together at a concert on Saturday evening. President Trump also made remarks via video.

right.title: Five ex-presidents and Trump champion unity, volunteerism at hurricane relief concert
right.body: All five living former presidents took the stage together at Saturday evening's hurricane relief charity concert in Texas, displaying a sense of unity and speaking of the importance of volunteerism and community in the face of natural disasters.
